06-03-1337 is March 6, 1337.  
330 days later:  
1337 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100/400 rules? 1337 mod 4 = 1, so not leap).  
Days remaining in March 1337 after Mar 6: 25 days.  
April–Dec 1337: 30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 275 days.  
Total from Mar 6 to end of 1337: 25 + 275 = 300 days.  
330 - 300 = 30 days into 1338.  
January 1338 has 31 days, so 30 days into Jan is Jan 30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1338-01-30
